items.name: Calcified Brood-Crystal
items.description: White crystal off a salted Weave-Eater, jagged as the day it set (book1 ch.20:205). It still holds salt's structure. Tynara Embercoil wants three.

items.name: The Unraveller's Heart, salted
items.description: Her core, calcified white. Something still moves inside it, like smoke under glass.

items.name: Uneaten Glass-Steel Blade
items.description: A First Era blade of glass-steel (book1 ch.7:149), a hundred years in her and not a mark on it. It hums when you hold it. Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Glass-Steel Hammer Head
items.description: A hammer head of glass-steel that sits heavier in the hand than it should, as if it pulled (book2 ch.13:23). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Glass-Steel Dirks
items.description: Two Lowtown dirks of glass-steel, tied together with a rotted cord. Somebody kept to the Rules (book1 ch.1:257-259). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Glass-Steel Stiletto
items.description: A singing stiletto of glass-steel. Tap it and it gives a note, thin and clear (book3 ch.4:46). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Leviathan-Bone Limbs
items.description: Bow limbs of petrified leviathan bone, like the harpoons she could not eat (book1 ch.20:177-181). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Void-Iron Haft
items.description: A haft of void-iron, cold and dark, from a staff of two ends (book1 ch.26:69, 137). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Amber-Wood Stave
items.description: A stave of amber-wood, warm and clear; the Unmaking slid off it (book1 ch.20:181; world_bible.md:70). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Bone Tuning Staff
items.description: A pilgrim's bone staff with a stoppered jar at its head. Something hums in the jar (world_bible.md:74-78). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Salt-Stone Maul Head
items.description: A maul head of salt-stone, rough and white, made the old way of scrap and sea-salt (book3 ch.1:70). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Harpoon Head
items.description: A bone harpoon head of the Ash-Walkers' kind, a scrap of amber rope still knotted through it (book1 ch.20:177-191). Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Uneaten Glass-Steel Mace Head
items.description: A mace head of glass-steel with a ring for a lantern. GAME-ONLY: no clerics in the books. Tynara Embercoil can remake it.

items.name: Verse of the Forge
items.description: A verse of the Original Song (world_bible.md:74-75). PROVISIONAL: from the Forge District's world boss, not yet in the game.

items.name: Verse of the Deep
items.description: A verse of the Original Song. PROVISIONAL: from the Warrens' world boss, not yet in the game.

items.name: Verse of the Crown
items.description: A verse of the Original Song. PROVISIONAL: from the Spire's or the Crown's world boss, not yet in the game.

items.name: A Note of the Original Song
items.description: Three verses make one note: only the Original Song can close the Fracture (world_bible.md:74-75). It wakes an uneaten weapon.

items.name: Second Truth
items.description: A glass-steel longsword, pale as salt, a seam of white crystal down the fuller. It hums in the teeth (book1 ch.17:25). Afterimage: every 5th blow leaves a gold afterimage that strikes again for 40%.

items.name: The Iron Anchor
items.description: A glass-steel war hammer with a pull of its own (book2 ch.13:23; world_bible.md:19). The Anchor: falling under 30% health roots you and takes 25% off every blow for 6 s, once a minute.

items.name: The Two Rules
items.description: A pair of glass-steel dirks: Exist Elsewhere, and Never Interfere (book1 ch.1:257-259). Exist Elsewhere: a blow of over 20% of your health moves you 5 m behind your foe, once every 30 s.

items.name: The Song of Sifting
items.description: A singing stiletto of glass-steel (book3 ch.4:46). It sings a note only the held can hear. Sifting: your holds last 20% longer, and the first blow on a held foe as it breaks does 30% more.

items.name: The Salt-Wall Bow
items.description: A longbow of leviathan bone and glass-steel, strung with amber cord (book1 ch.20:177; book3 ch.8:36). Salt-Tipped: every 6th shot does 50% more and strips one good effect (double on things of the Void).

items.name: The Sun-Staff
items.description: A double-ended staff on a void-iron haft, gold at both ends (book1 ch.26:69). Sunfire: a spell cast at full Heat leaves a 3 m patch of sunfire for 4 s (foes only).

items.name: Amber-Wood Crook
items.description: A crook of amber-wood, warm and clear as the Root-Mother's (world_bible.md:70). Amber: every 20 s your next heal wraps its target in amber (a ward no Weave-Eater can eat), or in a damage form your next blow roots for 1.5 s.

items.name: The First Verse
items.description: A bone staff with an echo-jar at its head (world_bible.md:74-78; book1 ch.13:73). Echo-Jar: every 8th spell is kept in the jar, and your next spell is echoed at 50%.

items.name: Mender's First Tool
items.description: A salt-stone maul, made of scrap and sea-salt (book3 ch.1:70-74; Salt of the First Sea, book1 ch.20:199). Salt Line: a salt working also calcifies its foe for 2 s, once every 20 s.

items.name: Grohl's Harpoon
items.description: A bone harpoon on amber rope, Ash-Walker made (book1 ch.20:177-191; ch.25:25). Grounding: every 20 s your next spell pins its target 3 s (no blink, no move); things of the Void are silenced too.

items.name: The Hill-Shrine Lantern
items.description: A glass-steel mace with a lantern hung from it (GAME-ONLY; the Song of Mending, world_bible.md:20). Kept Light: healing past full becomes a ward of up to 10% of the target's health for 8 s.

items.name: Harpooner's Coat
items.description: Oiled leather with amber cord at the cuffs, for the throwing arm.

items.name: Harpooner's Mail Coat
items.description: Mail sewn to a leather coat, amber cord at the cuffs: for those who hold the rope.

items.name: Harpooner's Robe
items.description: A long coat of oilcloth, amber cord at the cuffs: for those who call the throws.

items.name: Salt-Crusted Mantle
items.description: Salt dried white on it in rings, where the river splashed and she went white.

items.name: Brood-Bone Gauntlets
items.description: Bone plates from the river bed, on leather. Bone holds.

items.name: The Drain Reach Waders
items.description: Waders that have stood in the black water and come out whole. The river's poison is half as strong on you.

items.name: Knotted Amber Cord
items.description: Ketta's grandmother's way: a knot a pin.

items.name: Bone Buckler
items.description: A buckler of petrified bone. Steel lies; bone holds.
